system: Imagine you are a person in the situation. In one or two sentences, state your immediate interpretation and what you do next.
prompts: A coworker leaves a blank sticky note on your monitor.
The train display flickers, then returns to the same schedule.
A shop assistant says it will take five minutes to find your size.
A friend knocks twice on your door and waits outside.
The kettle clicks off a minute earlier than usual.
Your library card is declined once, then scans successfully.
Why do shadows become longer near sunset?
random_rule: Gaussian unit directions scaled to norm 3
